note: OVERRIDES for who owns a registered /NS/ namespace. The SAP-delivered set is DERIVED, not listed here: `oracle.sapNamespaces()` reads it from SAP's own released-API/classification registry under data/, on the principle that an object SAP classified is SAP-delivered, so its namespace is SAP's (44 namespaces at time of writing, including /SCWM/, /SAPAPO/, /UI2/, /BOBF/). Deriving rather than snapshotting is deliberate — a hand-copied list drifts from the registry exactly as validate-findings.js drifted from the schema. This file exists for the two things the registry cannot know.
customer_owned_note: YOUR registered namespaces. A namespace you licensed and build in is your data, and a RAP BO may own it. The registry cannot know this — it lists SAP's objects, not yours — so it is the one fact that must come from the landscape (SE03, or your namespace licence). Format: full namespace with both slashes, e.g. "/ACME/".
sap_delivered_note: ADDITIONS to the derived set, for an SAP add-on whose namespace the shipped registry does not cover. Normally empty — check `oracle.sapNamespaces()` before adding, the answer is usually already there.
unresolved_note: What a namespace in NEITHER the derived set nor these lists means. 'sap' is the fail-safe: claiming someone else's table HIDES a Clean-Core violation, while declining to claim your own costs the object a RAP BO root — which surfaces as an unmatched shape and escalates to a human. Never manufacture ownership from silence. Set to 'customer' only for a landscape where every registered namespace not known to SAP is certainly yours.
